layers.description: Topsoil: dark brown, moist, organic silt with roots and rootlets, abundant organic debris
Light brown, dry, well-graded GRAVEL with sand, subangular to subrounded, maximum size 50 mm
Reddish brown, stiff, moist, sandy lean clay with trace gravel; iron oxide staining on fracture surfaces
Thin seam of white volcanic ash, <25 mm thick
Gray elastic silt, very soft, wet
